import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    m = int(next(it))
    for _ in range(m):
        start = int(next(it))
        end = int(next(it))
        k = int(next(it))
        sub = arr[start:end+1]
        if sub:
            k %= len(sub)
            rotated = sub[-k:] + sub[:-k]
            arr[start:end+1] = rotated
    print(' '.join(map(str, arr)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
